Careers

Join Us

PowerCom is inspired to change energy outlook and utility management, the way electricity is consumed, managed and the collection of money for the services delivered to improve the infrastructure, the lives of the consumers and service delivery.   PowerCom does this through harnessing scientific know-how in smart grid related applications, designing innovative solutions with a high level of understanding customer needs to deliver the best smart metering, smart grid and revenue management solutions.

At Powercom, you will work with the world’s most talented software engineers, product managers, and thought leaders to shape the future of the Smart Grid.
